extracted.name: Grilled Honey-Lemon Chicken
extracted.description: Lemon juice and zest, honey, and Dijon mustard add their flavors to a sweet and tangy marinade that will make basic grilled chicken breasts into a family-pleasing treat.
instruction_lines: Mix canola oil, lemon zest, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, honey, garlic, Worcestershire sauce, Italian herb seasoning, salt, and black pepper in a bowl; pour into a resealable plastic bag. Place chicken breasts into the bag, seal, and squeeze bag with your fingers several times to coat chicken with marinade. Place a second resealable bag over the first and seal to prevent leaks. Refrigerate chicken for 2 to 4 hours.
Preheat grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate.
Remove chicken breasts from bag; discard used marinade. Cook chicken on the preheated grill until the center is no longer pink and the juices run clear, 7 to 8 minutes per side.
